verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents a dedicated Sandbox as a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features without real funds, which covers payments-type scenarios. However, evidence doesn't confirm sandbox/testnet coverage extends deterministically to payouts and conversions specifically, nor describe deterministic test values/behaviors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of testnet/sandbox coverage for payouts and conversions flows, description of deterministic test value behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox reliability.
